race.title: Hampden Agencies Mares' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: SAXONS PRIDE has offered encouragement when finishing third on both of her starts over hurdles so far, including over C&D on her return, and she can open her account with improvement to come now handicapping. The biggest threat could come from stablemate Ghost Dancing , while Guildhall Graduate is also considered on her handicap hurdle debut. SAXONS PRIDE GHOST DANCING GUILDHALL GRADUATE (IRE)
